profileLabel: Center-left economics; pro-accountability and rights-protecting (medium confidence)
summary: Bukidnon 2nd District representative with 116 principal-authored bills. Authored absolute divorce, extrajudicial killing as a heinous crime, strengthening the Commission on Human Rights, an anti-dynasty ban, a bar on relatives of officials in government contracts, universal health care, health worker benefits, debtor protection and a plastic-bag excise tax.
caveat: Divorce is the only social-values issue, so social values is not scored. Bill-based evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored universal health care and health worker benefits (-3), debt-collection limits protecting debtors (-2), a plastic-bag excise (-1) and removal of electricity system-loss charges (-1); co-authored minimum wage (-2).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB06728, HB03695, HB08223, HB06729, HB10795; co-author HB08081 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: no scorable evidence in reviewed bills (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Protective-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored classifying extrajudicial killing as a heinous crime (+3, due process and police accountability) and strengthening the Commission on Human Rights (+3). Two related issues.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01629, HB04835 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored an anti-dynasty ban (+3) and disqualification of officials' relatives from government contracts (+3). Consistent accountability agenda; two issues.
